name: Cycle
source:
Dead, alone, in limbo – Henry Crayfield has no memory of how he died. Isolation gnaws at him… until a sharp-tongued stranger arrives.

Why is he trapped? Who is this man? And what is the cycle?

[From [url=https://sunrise-man.itch.io/cycle]Itch.io[/url]]
